info.title: Foundry agent __AGENT__
info.description: Ask the Foundry hosted agent __AGENT__ a question. APIM calls the agent's Responses endpoint with its managed identity.

post.description: Ask the architect agent about this lab's architecture: networks, subnets, peerings, private DNS, private endpoints, Foundry accounts and models, the AI gateway (APIM) and its APIs, the agent runtime, traffic flows, KQL to prove a path, and teardown caveats. Send one self-contained question; the answer is plain text grounded in the lab's knowledge base.
